68 (E)  ASSISTANCE FOR MARRIAGE 
 
 
1. 
Gist of the Scheme 
A sum of Rs.2,000/- (Rupees Two thousand only) is 
given to meet the marriage expenses of the applicant 
for his son or daughter. 
2. 
Eligibility Criteria 
Children of any differently abled person holding 
identity card. The differently abled person shall have 
attained the age as prescribed by law for marriage 
3. 
Whether the prescribed 
application form is available 
Yes. Available with District Differently abled Welfare 
Office. 
4. 
Certificates to be furnished 
Identity card issued by the welfare board for the 
differently abled, birth certificate and proof of 
marriage. 
5. 
Officer to 
whom 
the 
application is to be 
submitted 
District Differently Abled Welfare Officer 
6. 
Grievances if any to be 
addressed to 
Assistant Director (DAW), 
O/o. The Commissionerate  for Welfare of the  Differently 
abled, 
No.5, Kamarajar salai, 
Chennai – 600 005.  
Ph: 044-28444940
